job_title: AI / ML & Full-Stack Software Engineer (Graduate / Entry-Level)
pool_summary: The contender pool separates into a few clear standout clusters: publication-oriented research, hands-on computer-vision/AI implementation, and end-to-end product builders with real-time or quantified usage. International/selective research exposure is rarer, while most candidates show only project-level full-stack or research evidence without measured production impact.

axes.label: Publication-Backed Research Depth
axes.rationale: For an entry-level Applied AI role, demonstrated research output is a stronger differentiator than merely listing machine-learning skills or coursework. The pool contains a small publication cluster and a broader group with research-assistant or research-intern exposure but no scholarly output.
axes.strong_criteria: At least two completed peer-reviewed or formally published technical research outputs with active authorship ownership [action], preferably involving AI, computer vision, optimization, or systems methods; this matches the highest research signal observed in the pool.
axes.moderate_criteria: Active research-assistant or research-intern ownership of a technical investigation, dataset, or model without publication evidence, or one completed publication/project with research framing. Passive lab participation or a generic AI project alone does not qualify as strong.
axes.estimated_pool_prevalence: 3/10 candidates show strong or moderate evidence

axes.label: Quantified AI/CV System Ownership
axes.rationale: The job emphasizes production AI/ML, yet most candidates provide only unquantified project descriptions. The upper pool is distinguished by personally building a model or vision system with an explicit accuracy, recognition, or processing outcome.
axes.strong_criteria: Personally built and implemented an AI, machine-learning, or computer-vision system [action] with a concrete performance or operational metric, such as the 98% classifier accuracy observed in this pool, or an implemented OCR/ANPR pipeline with a clearly defined recognition/conversion outcome.
axes.moderate_criteria: Active ownership [action] of a nontrivial AI/CV model or pipeline—such as classification, OCR, ANPR, EEG processing, or recommendation—without a quantified result, or a quantified ML exercise that lacks evidence of an end-to-end system. Peripheral contribution, coursework, or a tool listing is insufficient for strong.
axes.estimated_pool_prevalence: 3/10 candidates show strong or moderate evidence

axes.label: Real-Time Product Engineering Scale
axes.rationale: Full-stack capability is common in this pool, but real-time behavior and explicit usage scale provide a more selective signal for production product engineering. This axis distinguishes candidates who moved beyond CRUD-style applications into concurrent messaging, WebSocket services, or workflow systems.
axes.strong_criteria: Actively built [action] an end-to-end real-time or workflow product across frontend and backend layers, with explicit concurrency or operational scale such as approximately 100 concurrent users, WebSocket-based interaction, or an equivalent measurable system behavior.
axes.moderate_criteria: Actively built [action] a multi-layer web or mobile product using backend, database, and frontend components, including a real-time, workflow, booking, marketplace, or recommendation feature, but without explicit scale metrics or demonstrated production operation.
axes.estimated_pool_prevalence: 5/10 candidates show strong or moderate evidence

axes.label: International Research Environment
axes.rationale: The role explicitly values selective labs and international experience, and this pool contains a rare international academic/research signal distinct from ordinary internships or local project work. It indicates exposure to different research standards and engineering environments, but should not substitute for proof of technical ownership.
axes.strong_criteria: Verified participation in an international university, exchange, or research-lab environment with distinction or active technical contribution [action], such as an overseas research internship plus distinguished exchange performance; the candidate must show more than attendance or a passive affiliation.
axes.moderate_criteria: Verified active placement in a selective university research lab or technical lab, or international academic exposure without both a distinguished outcome and substantial technical ownership. Local lab affiliation alone is moderate only when paired with a concrete research role or output.
axes.estimated_pool_prevalence: 4/10 candidates show strong or moderate evidence
